Definition: from G3441 and G1096; only-born, i.e. sole:--only (begotten, child).
BiblicalUsage: Monogenes means only-begotten, the only one of its kind — John says the Word became flesh and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, and no man has seen God, but the only begotten Son has declared Him. God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, and Abraham offered up Isaac, his only begotten son.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the deepest word about Jesus in the whole New Testament. He is not one son among many, He is the only one, and the giving of Him is the measure of God's love.
RelatedTopics: Son of God; Love of God; Faith
